D: Jackie Moon owns, coaches and plays for the Flint Tropics, a 1976 basketball team fighting to survive the merger.
P: Serve the snacks at the Tropics' tip-off.
S: Grilled hot dogs with spiced beef chilli sauce, mustard and onion
Hot dogs in soft buns topped with a dry, finely ground spiced beef coney sauce, mustard and diced onion, the Flint way.
Coconut crumbed prawns, fried golden, with mango chilli sauce

King prawns crumbed in coconut and panko, fried until crunchy, with a sticky mango, lime and chilli dipping sauce. Peel 600g green king prawns, leaving tails on. Dust in 50g plain flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs, then press into 60g desiccated coconut mixed with 60g panko. Fry in oil at 180C for 2 minutes until golden and drain. Simmer the flesh of 1 mango with 3 tbsp sweet chilli sauce, the juice of 1 lime and 1 chopped red chilli for 3 minutes, then blitz smooth. Serve the prawns hot with the sauce.
M: Slow-baked ribs glazed with barbecue sauce, buttered corn and slaw
Sticky barbecue pork ribs basted until glossy, with buttered corn and coleslaw, a big seventies cookout plate.
W: Orange butter cake with mascarpone cream and orange glaze

Light orange butter sponge layered with whipped vanilla mascarpone cream, finished with orange glaze and zest, the colour of a Tropics jersey. Heat the oven to 180C. Beat 200g butter and 200g caster sugar, add 4 eggs one at a time and the zest of 2 oranges, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 60ml orange juice. Divide between two lined 20cm tins and bake 25 minutes. Cool. Whip 250g mascarpone, 200ml cream, 2 tbsp icing sugar and 1 tsp vanilla. Sandwich and top the cakes with the cream and drizzle over 100g icing sugar mixed with 2 tbsp orange juice.
K: Vodka, coffee liqueur and espresso shaken until foamy

Hot espresso shaken hard with vodka, coffee liqueur and brown sugar syrup into a thick crema, strained into chilled coupes with an orange twist. Chill 4 coupes. Pull 4 shots of espresso and cool 5 minutes. For each drink, shake 45ml vodka, 30ml coffee liqueur, 30ml espresso and 10ml brown sugar syrup with lots of ice for 15 seconds until foamy. Strain into the glass and twist a strip of orange peel over the top. For non-drinkers, shake the espresso with syrup, milk and ice instead.

veg.make_ahead: Make the mango sauce up to 2 days ahead in the fridge and crumb the cauliflower up to 4 hours ahead; fry to serve

steps.text: Cut the cauliflower into bite-size florets.
Dust in the plain flour, dip in the beaten eggs, then press into the desiccated coconut mixed with the panko.
Fry in the oil at 180C for 4 minutes until golden and tender, then drain.
Simmer the flesh of the mango with the sweet chilli sauce, the juice of the lime and the chopped red chilli for 3 minutes, then blitz smooth.
Serve the cauliflower hot with the sauce.

steps.text: Rub the pork ribs with salt, pepper and smoked paprika, wrap in foil and bake at 160C for 2 hours.
Unwrap, brush with the barbecue sauce and grill until sticky.
Boil the corn cobs and toss in the butter. Serve with the ribs and the coleslaw mixed with mayonnaise.

veg.make_ahead: Rub the mushrooms with the oil and spices up to 4 hours ahead in the fridge; roast, glaze and grill to serve

steps.text: Halve the king oyster mushrooms lengthways and score the cut sides. Rub with the oil, salt, pepper and smoked paprika.
Roast at 200C until browned and tender.
Brush with the barbecue sauce and grill until sticky.
Boil the corn cobs and toss in the butter.
Serve with the buttered corn and the coleslaw mixed with mayonnaise.
